deploy.before: Production was dpl_BV6NJVDFDc1KCSX3iMz2JFR6ogj5 (main 9cb39d3f, #543). Main's only change beyond it besides #544 was the #545 release record. No Convex, package or lockfile change, so no Convex push.

changes: The chosen question topic is kept for the browser tab (sessionStorage visibible-ask-topic), so Ask opens on it at every verse; Meaning in a new tab.

A verse or chapter of Psalms reads "Psalm 23:4" in the suggested questions, the page title, Contents, captions, the picture menu and alt and aria text; the book stays "Psalms". Requests, verse ids, stored pictures, videos and answers and the public image API keep "Psalms 23:4".
On a phone the question topics are one row that scrolls sideways to the screen's edges, with the chosen topic scrolled into view. The computer foot is unchanged.
The Ask page's verse quote no longer shows the cut-off fourth line of a long verse.

smoke.after: Production at 390 x 844 (phone), a new guest, chat, painting, video and invoice requests blocked. At John 1:5 the guest opened Ask and chose For today, then went to Psalms 23:4: the title read "Psalm 23:4 - Visibible", the Ask header "PSALM 23:4", For today was still chosen and scrolled into view in a one-line (33 px) scrolling row, and its questions read "How can I apply Psalm 23:4 today?" and "What can I pray about from Psalm 23:4?". No question was sent.

rollback.vercel: Promote dpl_BV6NJVDFDc1KCSX3iMz2JFR6ogj5. Psalms suggestions return to the "Psalms 23:4" wording, whose stored answers are still there until they expire.

knownEffects: Stored answers to Psalms suggestions were keyed by the old wording, so they are no longer served; the first reader to ask each again gets a new answer (free or paid as usual).
